Nivel de vechime: Nu se aplică
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
As a leading provider of software solutions for the healthcare sector, we operate in 19 countries and employ over 9,000 dedicated staff. You will work in a dynamic and innovative environment that is full of opportunities. With your commitment and passion, you will have the opportunity to make a lasting difference.
Together, we are shaping the healthcare system of the future. Become part of our mission and make a difference – for a world where knowledge saves lives!
 Your Contribution
As an essential part of our IT Security team, you ensure that the security of our products and services operates seamlessly together.
In the event of security incidents, you keep a cool head and ensure secure 24/7 operation in our SOC, even when on call.
You built Supply Chain Security in our existing security incident processes
Your knowledge helps with prioritizing vulnerability management to important company resources
Your communication skills support our colleagues with effective vulnerability management and incident handling
 What You Bring
Experience in IT security, in particular the setup and operation of a SOC
Degree in computer science, business informatics of comparable degree/training with a focus on IT security
Experience in areas such as networks, operating systems, cloud solutions, container security, digital forensics, threat intelligence, threat hunting, or malware analysis, are advantageous
Nice to have CISSP, CCSP, CSA, or OSCP certifications
Very good English language skills
Ability to work in a team, strong communication skills, analytical thinking and independent working style
